name: spipe
description: SPipe scoped research, guarded release sessions, planning, process guidance, and MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Scope-aware research and guarded release tools
interface.longDescription: Guide research through authorized common, company, organization, project, user, and host wikis with evidence provenance and retained runtime state. Shared discovery/context APIs are planned. Create and sync token-owned local Git release sessions and explain broker-bound scoped self-review admission without claiming an APPROVED review.
defaultPrompt: Start or verify an owned release worktree.
Check reviewed fixes for beta backporting.
Create a server-side review request for a repository, pull request, session, or feature.
Explain why I cannot approve my own GitHub pull request and evaluate SPipe self-review admission.
Research this project through its authorized SPipe wiki scopes and report evidence provenance.
